## Article 45 Duration

The entire Agreement will be for a two-year period beginning July 1, 1993, and ending June 30, 1995. Either party to this Agreement may reopen negotiations on wages and benefits for FY 1995. If requested, such reopener will comply with the provisions of Article 5 herein.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereunto set their hands and seals this third day of June, 1993.
